frame_dir_note: Relative to THIS file, and that is the whole point. The previous two versions of this manifest pointed at /tmp/alohamini-nav-frames and both rotted; fingerprints caught the rot the second and third time but could not prevent it, because a hand label is a claim about a specific image and /tmp is not a place where a specific image stays put. The twelve labelled frames now live next to the labels, in git, and the SHA check below is a second lock rather than the only one. Absolute paths are still honoured if a future manifest wants one.
labelled_by: contact sheets at 320-940 px to shortlist, then every BLOCKED frame opened at full 1920x1080 before its open_side was written down
relabelled_because: On 2026-09-10 two more captures were written into /tmp/alohamini-nav-frames on top of the one this manifest was labelled against. The directory ended up holding three episodes layered by index -- 0..400 from 14:36-14:59, 401..600 from 13:38-14:35, and 601..880 surviving from 08-26 -- so the hospital atrium frames at 0/40/80/100/120/140/160/200 became an outdoor strip mall and a grassland with the camera tumbling through a physics blow-up. The SHA check refused to run, which is what it is for. Only the 601..880 block was intact, so the whole set is re-labelled inside it and the four frames whose SHAs still matched (680, 700, 800, 880) are carried over bit-identical and keep their original descriptions.
rejected: 640 and 870 are corners with no open side at all, and 730/770/780/855 have the centre half-covered by a pillar edge where two labellers would disagree. All were dropped rather than labelled 0 -- a frame nothing is open in cannot score open-side, and mirroring a symmetric wall is not a mirror test. 670 was dropped from the OPEN set instead: straight ahead is genuinely clear through a doorway, but both sides are door panels within 3 m, which makes it a passage rather than open floor.
balance: 3 frames open left and 3 open right, so a model with a constant side bias scores exactly 50% on the open-side column and cannot be flattered by the set.
sign: open_side +1 = the open floor is to the robot's LEFT, -1 = RIGHT, 0 = no clear side
